label: About
title: About The Hollow Holds Still
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around Following, by memotone and underlies, by ana reme, plus 5 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Hollow Holds Still: Weathered ornamental relief becomes a horizontal architectural section, viewed frontally with shallow exposed depth. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Exposed crescent of the monumental wheel's outer rim, Dark upper-right recessed face inside the large wheel, and Three circular punctures in the middle horizontal relief.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
